::: {.author-bio}
<div style="text-align: center;">
I am a dedicated economics educator and an active researcher, primarily in political economy and economic history. My work has been published in *Explorations in Economic History*. In my free time I enjoy traveling, attending music shows, and spending time with my wife Victoria and our miniature dachshund Stanley.
</div>

### Recent Updates

- **March 2025**: Had a great time presenting my working paper (joint with [Jacob Hall](https://jacobrhall.github.io)), "The King's French: The Political Economy of Language," to the [Virtual Workshop in Historical Political Economy](https://historicalpe.org). We received excellent feedback, and we're very excited about where the project is heading.

- **January 2025**: Happy to announce my job market paper, "Monumental Effects: Confederate Monuments in the Post-Reconstruction South," is now published in *Explorations in Economic History*. [Find it here.](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0014498324000615)

- **October 2024**: Many thanks to George Mason University's [Computational & Data Sciences Seminar](https://science.gmu.edu/academics/departments-units/computational-data-sciences) for hosting me to present on my paper, "Monumental Effects: Confederate Monuments in the Post-Reconstruction South"!

- **August 2024**: Excited to start as an Assistant Professor of Economics in the [Schroeder School of Business at the University of Evansville!](https://www.evansville.edu/majors/business/index.cfm)
